title: DHRUVA Canonical Telemetry Message
description: Schema for one telemetry reading matching the backend integration contract. Exactly 8 fields, no extras.
title: UAVTelemetryMessage

engine_id.description: Unique identifier for the UAV engine instance (e.g. ENG001)

temperature.description: Engine temperature in deg C. May be null during sensor dropout.

oil_pressure.description: Engine oil pressure in psi. May be null during sensor dropout.

fuel_flow.description: Fuel flow rate in L/h. May be null during sensor dropout.

altitude.description: Altitude in metres above sea level.

temperature.description: Cylinder Head / Exhaust Gas Temperature in Celsius

oil_pressure.description: Engine lubrication oil pressure in PSI

fuel_flow.description: Fuel consumption rate in liters per hour
